meta.name: ultrawork
meta.description: Binding ultrawork mode directive for omo-senpi. When a prompt contains ultrawork or ulw, the omo input hook injects the full directive as a hidden custom message (customType omo-ultrawork:directive, display false) ahead of the user's text, which is left untouched; a prompt queued while the agent is streaming instead carries the directive appended inside that same message. The directive is present in the conversation context; on the idle path it is not shown in the visible prompt, while a queued prompt carries the directive visibly (exactly as before this change). When the directive is already present in the conversation, do not read this file again - this file is that same directive. Read this file only when ultrawork mode is requested and the directive is not already present in the conversation.

copy.tagline: 启用预设的强化工作模式
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你希望用特定词触发系统进入工作状态。
copy.tagline_en: Activate a preset enhanced work mode.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want a keyword to switch the system into work mode.

howto.what: 激活后，Claude 会先显示'ULTRAWORK MODE ENABLED!'，然后严格按流程：先调查规划，任务分轻重两级，每个改动必须先写失败测试再让它通过，并在真实界面验证，全程记入记事本。
howto.when: 当你在对话中输入“ultrawork”或“ulw”时触发，系统注入完整指令并启动该模式。

say.text: 开启 ulw，修复登录 bug。
say.note: 会先写失败测试再实现，并验证。

say.text: 用 ulw 检查我的代码改动。
say.note: 会先调查、记录计划，再按层级验证。

say.text: ulw 部署并验证新功能。
say.note: 强制端到端测试与真实界面验证。

howto.what_en: Activated, Claude prints 'ULTRAWORK MODE ENABLED!' and follows a strict protocol: survey and plan first, classify LIGHT/HEAVY, every change must have a failing test that passes, plus real-surface verification; it keeps a durable notepad.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the prompt contains 'ultrawork' or 'ulw'. The full directive is injected as a hidden message (or carried visibly in queued prompts) and the mode starts.

say_en.text: Enable ulw and fix the login bug.
say_en.note: Runs strict flow: failing test first, then fix and verify.

say_en.text: Use ulw to review my code changes.
say_en.note: Surveys, plans, then validates with evidence.

say_en.text: Ulw: deploy and verify the new feature.
say_en.note: Forces end-to-end tests and real-surface proof.
